item.title: Hot vs Cold vs Bokashi: Which Composting Method Actually Wins? | Compost Culture
item.description: Three composting methods compared on the numbers that matter: timeline to finished compost, pathogen kill, nitrogen retention, and effort. Hot piles finish in 3-8 weeks, cold piles take a season or more, bokashi ferments in two weeks but needs a second step.

item.description: Six compost thermometers from $15 to $60 compared on the specs that actually matter: hermetic sealing, stem gauge, and calibration. What separates cheap dials from expensive ones, and which one fits your pile size.
